title: 吗 questions
explain: Put 吗 at the end of a statement to make a yes/no question.

title: Word order
explain: Who + verb + what + 吗: 他有狗吗？

title: 他, 她, not 你
explain: You are asking about the hidden person, so use 他 or 她.

title: 他 or 她
explain: Once you know someone is a woman, write 她; a man, 他.

title: Answer with the verb
explain: Chinese answers yes/no questions by repeating the verb.

title: 没有, not 不有
explain: 有 is made negative with 没, never with 不.
